title: Choose Bantay's operating world
question: Keep the grounded direction, take the strongest alternate, re-roll, or steer it.

options.label: Living Price Label
options.lineage: sari-sari shelf labels, owner price notes, and the Android camera viewfinder
options.body: The scanner is the working surface. A successful scan resolves into one large, unmistakable cream-and-orange price label; stock, sync, and last-updated details behave like precise owner annotations. Material 3 controls keep it native and trustworthy. The puppy appears only when guidance or reassurance is useful. Risk: literal label shapes could become decorative cards, so the system uses one dominant label only where price is the task.

options.label: Store Route Map
options.lineage: midnight transit diagrams fused with the scan-to-sale journey
options.body: Scan, identify, price, and record become a disciplined route with clear stations and exceptional state visibility. It is strong for process clarity, but its dark metropolitan language identifies less naturally with a warm neighborhood sari-sari store.
